items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I think -- I think Duke Burrell -- do you know Duke Burrell, the piano player? Duke Burrell was working there at that particular time

ctx.x: Yeah, dual, uh-huh. Double piano. And it was just out of sight, really. But this was the type of thing that used to happen in Los Angeles.

So this is -- I haven't been in the Swanee, and the last time I was there, oh, I guess it's been about -- maybe about four years or better, maybe four or five years ago. Someone was working there then. I can't remember who. I think -- I think Duke Burrell -- do you know Duke Burrell, the piano player?
